Udhayanidhi Stalin detained over alleged remarks against actor Trisha

Udhayanidhi Stalin was detained by police in Thanjavur following a complaint filed by the women's wing of the TVK party. The complaint alleged remarks made by Stalin against actor Trisha Krishnan. Stalin denied the allegations, stating his speech reviewed ministerial performance and highlighted farmers' issues, and that his words were not intended as a double entendre. He was later released on bail after a day of protests and detentions. The opposition condemned his arrest.
